target: unique principal bundle with group containing SU(3)_c is impossible from locked atoms (no free rank/Wilson/flux)

attempts.iso: SU(2)×SU(2)×U(1) (files: SU(2)×SU(2) lattice; briefing adds U(1))
attempts.why: The only compact isometry group forced by the locked 5-metric is Iso(T^{1,1})=SU(2)×SU(2)×U(1). SU(3)_c is not a factor. Adding a new simple factor is a knob unless locked data force that factor; they do not. Therefore a unique SU(3)_c bundle cannot arise from Iso. Burned weld Iso=SU(3)_c not retried.

attempts.scope: any SU(3) principal bundle on some unnamed leftover space
attempts.why: Locked integers (T_wall=13/2 not a Chern index; n_η; monodromy 24) do not vanish H^2/H^3 in this repo. Paper: secondary characteristic classes from locked integers are free maps, not a unique class. That shows many maps can exist, not that no SU(3) bundle can exist. Impossibility of existence is not proved. H0 leftover metric is a dependency, not computed.
attempts.h0_dependency: A leftover 4-fold carrying a bundle would need a unique Y^{14} reduction (H0); not performed.

attempts.scope: identification of Module A modes with the 3 of SU(3)
attempts.why: Module A gives three zero modes, not the 3 of SU(3). Identifying them with a color triplet is a burned extra map. That shows color is not forced. It does not prove no SU(3) bundle can exist.

absence_scope: FORCED: a unique SU(3)_c principal bundle cannot be derived from locked atoms (Iso has no SU(3)_c factor; extra factor is a knob). NOT FORCED: non-existence of every SU(3) bundle (attempt 2 failed).

final.honest_status: Unique color bundle is impossible here without a knob (FORCED). That does not ban all SU(3) bundles (UNKNOWN). Do not lock CP^2.

lemma.name: H1_no_unique_SU3c_bundle
lemma.statement: From locked isolate atoms, Iso(T^{1,1}) does not contain SU(3)_c and adding a factor is unforced, so a unique SU(3)_c principal bundle cannot be derived. Non-existence of all SU(3) bundles is not proved.
